description: PAID ($0.03 USDC via x402 on Base — Free-on-Miss: $0.00 charged if no deliverable email is found): Verified B2B Person Enrichment, Work Email Finder & LinkedIn-to-Email Resolver powered by Apollo.io. Accepts partial identifiers—(1) first_name + last_name + company domain or organization_name, (2) LinkedIn profile URL (linkedin_url), or (3) email (reverse email lookup)—and returns a deterministic JSON profile with deliverable work email, verification status, job title, seniority (founder, C-suite, VP, director), company firmographics (headcount, industry, founded year), and full employment history. Zero signup or API key required.

inputSchema.description: B2B Person Enrichment & Verified Work Email Finder (Apollo.io): Accepts flexible partial person identifiers—such as (1) LinkedIn profile URL only ('linkedin_url' or 'linkedin'), (2) work or personal email only ('email' for reverse email lookup), (3) name ('name' or 'first_name' + 'last_name') with company domain OR fuzzy company name ('domain', 'organization_name', or 'company', e.g. 'Meta' or 'meta.com'), or (4) Apollo person ID ('id')—and resolves a deterministic B2B executive/prospect profile with verified work email, job title, seniority, department, location, company firmographics, and employment history. Free-on-Miss: only settles payment ($0.03 USDC) when a verified person and deliverable email are returned.

_x402_payment.description: Optional x402 signed payment payload (if not passed via HTTP X-PAYMENT header)

domain.description: Company website domain or URL (e.g., 'apollo.io', 'stripe.com'). Also accepts a company name (e.g., 'Meta', 'Google') and automatically resolves the canonical domain.

email.description: Known work or personal email address for reverse-email enrichment into full LinkedIn, title, firmographics, and career history.

first_name.description: Target person's first name (e.g., 'Tim'). Optional if 'name', 'linkedin_url', 'email', or 'id' is provided.

id.description: Optional Apollo.io person ID for direct profile hydration.

last_name.description: Target person's last name (e.g., 'Zheng'). Optional if 'name', 'linkedin_url', 'email', or 'id' is provided.

linkedin_url.description: Public LinkedIn profile URL (e.g., 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/tim-zheng') to resolve directly into a verified work email and company profile.

name.description: Target person's full name (e.g., 'Tim Zheng'). Automatically split into first_name and last_name if needed.

organization_name.description: Company or organization name (e.g., 'Apollo.io', 'Meta', 'Google', 'Stripe') if exact domain is unknown.

reveal_personal_emails.description: Whether to include verified personal emails if a corporate work email is unavailable (default: false).

name: enrich_person
